title: Virtual cycles of 3-term complexes and the Hilbert schemes of surfaces
summary: Given a 3-term perfect complex E over a quasi-projective variety X and a nonnegative integer r, we define two virtual cycles and their refinements supported over the r-th degeneracy loci of E. This is done by modifying the complex E after pulling it back to certain blow ups of X. We establish several Thom-Porteous, comparison, duality and wall-crossing formulas for these virtual cycles. We apply this construction to perfect complexes arising from the universal objects over the Picard variety and the Hilbert schemes of non-singular complex projective surfaces.
